title: Measure, then change

blocks.md:
## Time a loop; do not guess

`performance.now()` (or `Date.now()`) before and after a loop tells you how long it took. Guessing “this feels slow” is not a measurement.

This lesson asks for the **count** you measured (`1000`), not a clever faster algorithm. Run the loop. Increment `n`. Print `n`.

The desk timed a thousand fox steps before anyone rewrote the walker. Change the path after you have a number, not because the loop looked long.

blocks.promptMd: You should rewrite a loop because it feels slow, even with no measurement.
blocks.explainMd: Measure first. This lesson’s proof is the count 1000 from the loop you actually ran.

hintLadder.md: Start `n` at `0`. Add one, a thousand times.
A `for` loop with `i < 1000` runs the body 1000 times.
